dusk_native.description: EMA 60m; threshold 200bp; step 50bp; interval 5m; dynamic cap 0bp; div 0; vol 0; vol half-life 15m

dusk_cpmm.description: independent CPMM candidate; EMA 30m; threshold 100bp; step 25bp; interval 5m; dynamic cap 0bp; div 0; vol 0; vol half-life 15m

profile_selection_policy.training_data: eight synthetic paths x four flow regimes x two seeds x fixed and elastic routing for Curve and concentrated Dusk; historical windows are not read; the CPMM lock is separate
profile_selection_policy.relaxation_rule: minimum fraction t -> t*(1-rho); maximum bounded fraction t -> t+rho*(1-t); maximum cost t -> t*(1+rho); one common rho is the smallest value admitting at least one hard-valid profile from each concentrated candidate system; CPMM is selected under its own rho
profile_selection_policy.selection_utility: within each system, minimize that profile's own required service relaxation first; then maximize the minimum across routes of 0.8*median fee-adjusted LP return + 0.2*p10 return; tie-break by mean route utility, higher minimum route capture, lower maximum route p90 execution cost, profile id

dusk_product_selection_policy.readiness_rule: Dusk is product-ready on synthetic training only when its own hard-valid selected profile passes every original fixed- and elastic-route service guardrail with rho=0. Curve's required relaxation cannot block or rescue this Dusk-only gate.

cpmm_product_selection_policy.training_data: the same eight synthetic paths x four flow regimes x two seeds x fixed and elastic routing; selected independently without entering the Curve/DH2 common relaxation or reading history
cpmm_product_selection_policy.selection_utility: within the CPMM family's own minimum service relaxation, maximize the same worse-route fee-adjusted LP-return utility
cpmm_product_selection_policy.recommendation_rule: the independently selected CPMM may remain an economic comparator when relaxation is positive, but it cannot receive a ship or product-ready recommendation unless relaxation is zero and the selected profile passes the original envelope

matching_basis_sensitivity_scope: non-optimized locked-controller diagnostic; controllers and fees were selected on the primary equal-aggregate-execution invariant match and are not reselected on alternate bases

locked_profile_volume_sensitivity.scope: locked-profile transfer test at fixed arrival frequency; controllers are not reselected for each volume regime

cpmm_product_fallback.comparison_scope: independently selected on synthetic training under the same route-service envelope; blind held-out product comparator

cpmm_matched_policy_ablation.comparison_scope: selected current-DH2 fee and controller held fixed; only peak_depth and fade_scale set to zero

locked_profile_lp_return_leader_at_equal.scope: LP-return-only result for locked profiles at the primary equal aggregate invariant execution index; execution cost, capture, and tracking remain separate; independent of ship gates and not a global capital-efficiency or family optimum

decision.rule: The selected Curve and concentrated-Dusk profiles must pass the original synthetic training service envelope before either can be called a universal winner, so their common relaxation must be zero. The independently selected CPMM uses a separate service relaxation and cannot alter that lock. A candidate must also pass independently in fixed and elastic routing: >=1 bp/12h median advantage, >=70% window wins, and a bottom-decile mean >= -1 bp. Every flow-by-route cell must avoid a median return reversal. Route, flow, and matching-basis tails must keep p90 execution regression <=1 bp, p10 capture advantage >=-2 percentage points, and p90 marginal-price tracking staleness regression <=5 percentage points. Finite-size raw quote costs remain separate depth/fee diagnostics. The result must also persist across source-ranked promoted policy shortlists, pool scales, one-minute cadence, and locked-profile 0.05x-to-4x daily-volume sensitivity. Alternate invariant matches are non-optimized diagnostics and do not enter this gate. In addition, a concentrated candidate must beat the Dusk CPMM product comparator under those same route and flow-by-route return and service thresholds.
